name: time-picker
title: Time picker
description: EDS-only component moved into the registry. Interval, 12/24h format, min/max and a subtle variant, on Radix Popover. Controlled with value/onChange (minutes from midnight), which fixes the eds-core TimePicker limitation.
docs: Values are minutes from midnight: <TimePicker label="Start" value={570} onChange={setStart} interval={30} />. Use variant="subtle" inside dense forms.
